boxes.name: Command line
interface: main(argv: [Text]) → ExitCode  // reads the command line and runs one command
cmd_add(url: Text)  // pocket add: saves one page
cmd_read(id: PageId)  // pocket read: prints a saved page
cmd_find(words: Text)  // pocket find: lists the pages that match

boxes.name: Pages
interface: save(url: Text) → PageId  // fetches, cleans and stores one page
read(id: PageId) → Page?  // one saved page
Page = { id: PageId, url: Text, title: Text, text: Text }  // one saved page

boxes.name: Cleaning
boxes.line: keeps the article, drops the rest
interface: clean(html: Text) → Text  // the readable text of a page

boxes.name: Search
boxes.line: finds saved pages by their words
interface: find(words: Text) → [Page]  // the pages that hold every word, best first

boxes.name: Store
interface: put(page: Page) → PageId  // stores one page
get(id: PageId) → Page?  // one page, or nothing

boxes.name: Fetching
interface: fetch(url: Text) → Text  // the HTML of one page, with a time limit

boxes.name: Notifier
boxes.line: says when a page is saved
interface: notify(title: Text)  // shows a desktop notice

links.label: commands
links.says: Every command calls Pages or Search.

links.label: pages
links.says: Saving a page downloads it through Fetching.

flows.name: Saving a page
flows.line: from the command to the stored page

steps.does: receives the add command and the address
